answer: Trust sits on tasks, not addresses. Each finished task mints a receipt bound to the worker key, and receipts decay 6 percent per idle epoch. Weight scales with independent confirming paths, so five accounts confirming each other collapse to one, an island that earns once. A farm buying 1,000 aged accounts holds decayed receipts worth near zero, and a prism view of the funding graph shows every ray leaving a walnut-sized seed wallet.
